sections.text:
```
+===========================================================================+
|                   PALEOZOIC ERA (538–252 Ma) — OVERVIEW                   |
+===========================================================================+
|                                                                           |
|  CAMBRIAN (538–485):   Explosion of animal body plans                     |
|  ORDOVICIAN (485–444): Great Ordovician Biodiversification Event          |
|  SILURIAN (444–419):   Recovery, vascular plants, jawed fish              |
|  DEVONIAN (419–359):   Age of Fishes, tetrapod emergence, trees           |
|  CARBONIFEROUS(359–299): Coal swamps, first flying insects, amniotes     |
|  PERMIAN (299–252):    Synapsids dominant, Pangaea, end-Permian disaster  |
|                                                                           |
|  CONTINENTAL CONFIGURATION:                                               |
|  Cambrian: Gondwana (S), Laurentia (N), Baltica (N), Siberia             |
|  Silurian: Laurentia + Baltica collide → Laurussia (Acadian orogeny)      |
|  Carboniferous: Gondwana + Laurussia → Pangaea assembly                  |
|  Permian: Pangaea nearly complete                                         |
+===========================================================================+
```
